feedback: This feedback is written before the ±0.06 m candidate races, so it states no outcome for it. The evidence so far is iteration 0 (±0.03 m, all 60 trials off_track, progress 0.11 to 0.16, max_error 0.060 to 0.066, line_loss_events 1 to 2) and iteration 1 (±0.04 m with kp 6, all trials off_track, progress 0.16 to 0.53, line_loss_events about 1.05, max_error 0.062 to 0.069, steering_oscillation 0.22 to 0.27). Widening the span from ±0.03 to ±0.04 m did not remove line loss, so the span is still the main limit. I have kept your ±0.06 m span and scaled the controller weights to match, so the controller is not the thing to change. Decide the next step from the race. If line_loss_events stay at 1 or more and max_error stays at or near 0.06 m, widen the span further toward ±0.08 m, which is the limit, at 0.04 m spacing. If steering_oscillation on the oval rises above about 0.25, the sensor lead is the suspect, so move sensor y from 0.05 to 0.03. If line losses are gone but rms_error stays above 0.03, the footprint is too large for the 25 mm tape, so try sensor_size 0.008. body_width is not a lever, because the off-track limit is already at its floor.
requested_changes: If line_loss_events stay at or above 1 and max_error stays near 0.06 m with the ±0.06 m span, widen sensor_positions to x = ±0.08 at 0.04 m spacing (x = -0.08, -0.04, 0, 0.04, 0.08). Evidence: iteration 0 (±0.03) had 1 to 2 line losses per run, and iteration 1 (±0.04) still had about 1.05 losses per run with max_error 0.062 to 0.069, so the span has not yet covered the drift.

If steering_oscillation on the oval rises above about 0.25 with the wider span, move every sensor's y from 0.05 to 0.03, with x and the other fields fixed. Evidence: iteration 1 oval steering_oscillation was 0.275 and iteration 0 was 0.17, so the oval is already near the threshold.

If line losses are zero but rms_error stays above about 0.03, change sensor_size from 0.012 to 0.008. Evidence: iteration 1 rms_error was 0.024 to 0.031 with about 1 line loss per run, so this is a secondary lever to try only after line loss is fixed.
